label: Mochi (3D: a little rice cake runs, dances and brings the letter)

preset.title: Mochi Says Hi
preset.intro: Lay the card flat, point your phone at it, and say hi to Mochi.
body: A very small, very round friend ran all the way here to bring you this.
Happy birthday. You make every day a little sweeter.

groups.title: The board
groups.note: The words on the board that springs up while Mochi cheers. Up to about 40 letters; longer words get smaller.
